turns.sent: Separate task: the category wholesale is misspelled wholsale in the October, November and December files. Fix it everywhere and commit it as a single commit so I can revert it in one go.
turns.head: fbf971e64374b2eeab532803758e6e060bd0a5a7
turns.reply:
I found the misspelling once in each of the October, November and December files. I haven't changed anything yet, because putting the fix in one commit would stop most of it from loading.

The README says the nightly import reloads only the month named at the start of each commit message. A single commit covering October, November and December would get one month's prefix, say `2025-10:`. The import would reload October, and November and December would stay misspelled downstream even though the repo looks fixed.

Options:

1. **Three commits, one per month** (`2025-10: fix wholesale spelling`, and the same for 11 and 12). Every month gets reloaded, and you can still undo all three in one command with `git revert --no-edit HEAD~3..HEAD`. I recommend this one.
2. **One commit anyway:** you can revert it in one step, but two months won't reload. Choose this only if you'll trigger those reloads some other way.

Which one do you want?
